
```{r}
# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(ona)
library(tma)
```

```{r}
# Load mock data and source program
mock_data <- read_csv("./mock_data_edited.csv")
source("../R/accum_multidim.R")
```

```{r}
mock_data <- mock_data %>% filter(chatGroup == "PAM") # just keep PAM for now
# Initialize TMA units and contexts
unit_cols <- c("userID", "condition")
codes <- c("A", "B", "C")
HOO_rules_model <- tma:::rules(
  modality %in% "chat" & chatGroup %in% UNIT$chatGroup & condition %in% UNIT$condition, modality %in% "resource" & userID %in% UNIT$userID & condition %in% UNIT$condition
)

context_model <- tma:::contexts(
  x = mock_data,
  units = unit_cols,
  hoo_rules = HOO_rules_model
)
```

potential senders: role, language, handwriting
potential receivers: role, language, handwriting
```{r}
# Test 1: Make a  multidim arr. with 1 sender, 1 receiver, 1 modality with both weights and windows filled in
# Does accum_multidim.R run? 
source("../R/accum_multidim.R")
# sender_cols = list("role") 
# receiver_cols = list("language")
# mode_column = list("modality")
# for now, don't have list
sender_cols = "role"
receiver_cols = "language"
mode_column = "modality"
time_column = "timeStamp"

# unique_senders = pull(unique(mock_data[,sender_cols[[1]]]))
# unique_receivers =  pull(unique(mock_data[,receiver_cols[[1]]]))
# unique_modes = pull(unique(mock_data[,mode_column[[1]]]))
unique_senders = pull(unique(mock_data[,sender_cols]))
unique_receivers =  pull(unique(mock_data[,receiver_cols]))
unique_modes = pull(unique(mock_data[,mode_column]))
weight_window_axis = c("weight", "window")

dim_names <- list(
  senders = unique_senders,
  receivers = unique_receivers,
  modes = unique_modes,
  weight_window = weight_window_axis
)

multidim_arr <- array(200, 
                  dim = c(length(unique_senders), 
                          length(unique_receivers), 
                          length(unique_modes), 
                          length(weight_window_axis)), 
                  dimnames = dim_names)


result_1 <- accum_multidim(
    multidim_arr, 
    unique_senders,
    unique_receivers,
    unique_modes,
    sender_cols,
    receiver_cols,
    time_column,
    mode_column,
    codes,
    context_model
)
print(result_1)
# Passed!
```

```{r}
source("../R/accum_multidim.R")
# Test 2: Do we get the correct standin matrix when specifying just a modality?
dim_names <- list(
  modes = unique_modes,
  weight_window = weight_window_axis
)
multidim_arr <- array(0, 
                  dim = c(length(unique_modes), 
                        length(weight_window_axis)), 
                  dimnames = dim_names)
multidim_arr["chat", "weight"] <- 1
multidim_arr["resource", "weight"] <- 2
multidim_arr["chat", "window"] <- 360
multidim_arr["resource", "window"] <- 360

result_new <- accum_multidim(
    multidim_arr, 
    unique_senders = list(),
    unique_receivers = list(),
    unique_modes,
    sender_cols = list(),
    receiver_cols = list(),
    time_column,
    mode_column,
    codes,
    context_model
)

result_old <- tma:::accumulate_contexts (
    x = context_model,
    codes = codes,
    weight.by = function(x) { x },
    decay.function = function(x) {
        modality_effect <- c("chat" = 360, "resource" = 360)
        modality_weight_effect <- c("chat" = 1, "resource" = 2)
        modality <- FULL_CONTEXT[ROWS, modality]
        weight <- (x < (modality_effect[modality])) * modality_weight_effect[modality]
        return(weight)
    },
    time.column = "timeStamp",
    return.ena.set = FALSE,
    mode.column = "modality"
)

print(result_old$connection.counts)
print(result_new)

# run roxygen2::roxygenise() before running these tests, b/c otherwise it stops utilizing our change to o.g. accum func
#'*works* when windows are the same (tried 180, 360, 720)  
#'*works* when weights are the same (tried 1, 2, 4) 
#'*works* when weights are different (e.g. c = 2, r = 1)
#'*works* when windows are different (c = 360, resource = 180)
```


```{r}
# Test 3: Do we get the correct answer with just a sender? 
source("../R/accum_multidim.R")
unique_senders = pull(unique(mock_data[,sender_cols]))


dim_names <- list(
  senders = unique_senders,
  weight_window = weight_window_axis
)
multidim_arr <- array(0, 
                  dim = c(length(unique_senders), 
                        length(weight_window_axis)), 
                  dimnames = dim_names)

multidim_arr["Mentor", "weight"] <- 1
multidim_arr["Player", "weight"] <- 2
multidim_arr["Mentor", "window"] <- 360
multidim_arr["Player", "window"] <- 360

result_new <- accum_multidim(
    multidim_arr, 
    unique_senders = unique_senders,
    unique_receivers = list(),
    unique_modes = list(),
    sender_cols = sender_cols,
    receiver_cols = list(),
    time_column,
    mode_column = list(),
    codes,
    context_model
)

result_old <- tma:::accumulate_contexts (
    x = context_model,
    codes = codes,
    weight.by = function(x) { x },
    decay.function = function(x) {
        role_window_effect <- c("Mentor" = 360, "Player" = 360)
        role_weight_effect <- c("Mentor" = 1, "Player" = 2)
        role <- FULL_CONTEXT[ROWS, role]
        weight <- (x < (role_window_effect[role])) * role_weight_effect[role]
        return(weight)
    },
    time.column = "timeStamp",
    return.ena.set = FALSE,
    mode.column = "role"
)

print(result_old$connection.counts)
print(result_new)

#'*works*: in equal windows equal weights case
#'*doesn't work* in inequal weights case--try mentor = 1, player = 2 
```

```{r}
# Test 4: Do we get the correct answer with just a receiver? 
source("../R/accum_multidim.R")

dim_names <- list(
  receivers = unique_receivers,
  weight_window = weight_window_axis
)
multidim_arr <- array(0, 
                  dim = c(length(unique_receivers), 
                        length(weight_window_axis)), 
                  dimnames = dim_names)
multidim_arr["L1", "weight"] <- 1
multidim_arr["L2", "weight"] <- 1
multidim_arr["L1", "window"] <- 360
multidim_arr["L2", "window"] <- 360

result_new <- accum_multidim(
    multidim_arr, 
    unique_senders = list(),
    unique_receivers = unique_receivers,
    unique_modes = list(),
    sender_cols = list(),
    receiver_cols = receiver_cols,
    time_column,
    mode_column = list(),
    codes,
    context_model
)

accum_ordered_receiving <- tma:::accumulate_contexts (
    x = context_model,
    codes = codes,
    weight.by = function(x) { x },
    decay.function = function(x) {
        learner_effect <- c("L1" = 1, "L2" = 1)
        learner <- FULL_CONTEXT[RESPONSE_INDEX, language]
        weight <- (x < (360)) * learner_effect[learner]
        return(weight)
    },
    time.column = "timeStamp",
    return.ena.set = FALSE,
    mode.column = "language"
)

print(result_old$connection.counts)
print(result_new)

#'*works*: in equal windows equal weights case
```
